0022600035.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-11, 0-5 on the road, 15th in the East) are on an eight-game losing streak as they visit the Orlando Magic (4-7, 0-4 at home, 10th in the East), who have won two straight. For Milwaukee, Myles Turner (rest) and Ryan Rollins (head) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. For Orlando, Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain) are out, while Jamal Cain (shoulder bruise) and Tristan da Silva (calf strain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the two teams have not met yet in 2026-27. The Bucks lost 1-2 to the Magic in the 2025-26 season series, including a 130-91 loss in Milwaukee on March 8, 2026.
